notes:
Notes (shorthand):
- Company: VerityLoop Insights — mid-market analytics SaaS, product search + contextual suggestions inside app.
- Primary ask: replace brittle heuristic reranker with ML rerank endpoint, improve top-k relevance (MRR/NDCG).
- Current infra: Elastic for inverted index, Python-based feature pipeline that computes signals; they want Redwood to take rerank/score layer.
- Traffic: 120M queries/month, peak qps ~60, typical qps 10–20. Batch offline scoring for nightly re-ranks ~2M items.
- Latency targets: p50 <= 150ms for rerank endpoint (cold); p95 <= 350ms. Throughput: per-request top-100 candidate scoring, average candidates=50.
- Quality metrics: will supply labeled eval set (5k queries) — measuring MRR@10, NDCG@10, precision@1. Want Redwood to support offline scoring + tie to eval/threshold alerts.
- Model prefs: start with open models / Redwood-verified small/med variants; open to quantized variants for Dedicated. Need fallback policy for capacity constraints.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market — looking for predictable committed capacity pricing (Dedicated) after Hosted POC. Target ARR range matches estimate.
- Security: SSO + SAML required for console; audit logs and KMS for keys; data residency preference for NA region. Legal asks retention controls and ability to purge PII on demand.
- POC scope: 2-week offline scoring run (customer provides eval + candidate set), 1-week online A/B in Hosted (traffic split 10%) then sizing for Dedicated nodes.
- Success criteria: improves MRR@10 by >=8% vs baseline OR reduces manual tuning time by >50%.
- Quotes from CPO: "We need deterministic improvement in top results — we can't afford noisy regressions."
- Internal champions: Head of Search (Lara Benton) and Staff ML Eng (Ravi Kapoor).
- Sales notes: Alicia to finalize POC SOW; Devon to create Dedicated sizing estimate; legal loop expected 2–3 weeks.
- Risks: heavy offline scoring volume may push cost; VPC egress constraints unclear — infra needs clarity on cross-region calls.
- Action items: upload eval set to shared drive, set up SSO trial tenant, schedule infra sizing call w/ infra team (Devon + Cloud Ops).
- Stubs/links: ff_20241021_demo_call_verityloop (recording), drive://redwood/proposals/verityloop_pricing_v2.pdf, INF-7421 (support ticket for initial sizing).
